more_info.overview: Sodium sorbate is the sodium salt of sorbic acid, identified by JECFA as a preservative preparation. Its preservative function is to limit microbial spoilage during storage. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-25 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1985). This is a combined sorbic-acid and sorbate limit, expressed as sorbic acid.
